crossRefs.note: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,
God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.
crossRefs.keyword: upon man. Heb. upon him. he gather

translations.kjv: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
